title: TxSprint
description: (lifestealsmp.com) Makes it impossible to not sprint (vanilla-friendly). Not sprinting is useless.
body:
This mod makes it so you always sprint when you can. It ignores the sprinting keybind.

It respects all vanilla features, such as automatically unsprinting under blindness effect, low hunger, etc...

Support server: discord.gg/lifestealsmp
